project_09_provenance_note: No formal Project 09 package/revision ID accompanied the task order's approved EN/PT values; none is fabricated here. The task order states Project 09 EN/PT localization authority as an upstream authority and supplies the description and type values as approved for verbatim use. checked_display EN/PT strings are deliberately NOT included in this package: the task order supplied only the raw checked_at date (2026-09-17), not approved display copy, and this repository has no generic/mechanical checked-date-to-display-string formatting rule to inherit from — every checked_display value elsewhere in the corpus is an individually hand-governed Project 09 string pair. Inventing EN/PT wording here and labeling it approved would overstate the linguistic authority actually granted, so the two checked_display keys are withheld pending an explicit Project 09 EN/PT pair for "Checked 17 September 2026". The Mindelo Essentials checked-date paragraph is correspondingly omitted from both records' markup; checked_at is retained as internal directory metadata only.
intent: Supplies the governed EN/PT type_label and description presentation values for the two Project 03-selected Fragata branch records newly added to the Mindelo Essentials canonical directory: SV-MIN-MKT-003 (Fragata — Central) and SV-MIN-MKT-004 (Fragata — Monte Sossego). Strictly additive: introduces four new keys, reopens no existing key, and changes no lifecycle, publication, spatial or identity field. Deliberately excludes checked_display (see project_09_provenance_note) pending Project 09 approval of that exact EN/PT pair.

rows.source_en: Fragata is a local supermarket network. The provider advertises customer support and scheduled delivery; check directly with Fragata for current availability and coverage.
rows.pt: A Fragata é uma rede local de supermercados. O prestador anuncia apoio ao cliente e entregas programadas; confirme diretamente com a Fragata a disponibilidade atual e a área de cobertura.
rows.context_notes: Provider-level description shared by both selected Fragata branches; deliberately does not claim branch-specific delivery, online ordering, stock or pricing.
